optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
           sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
           SUM(SR_FEE) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk
),
avg_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ctr_store_sk,
           AVG(ctr_total_return) AS avg_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
          AND s_state = 'TN'
JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > (
    SELECT ar.avg_return * 1.2
    FROM avg_returns ar
    WHERE ar.ctr_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
)
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100
